## PR description
### Fix Voxtral TTS feedback and short ASR checks  [labels: ready]
• ## Summary

  Fixes Voxtral TTS CI failure where generated audio did not match the input text.

  This PR related to https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/issues/4949

  Root cause: after the inter-stage payload refactor, Voxtral TTS postprocess writes generated codec frames as
  `codes.audio`, but `tts_preprocess` still only consumed legacy top-level `audio`. Decode feedback therefore missed
  previous audio-code embeddings, causing unrelated spoken output such as `I don't know, sorry.`

  Also relaxes the speech transcript assertion for very short clips when Whisper repeats a word, while still rejecting
  unrelated transcripts.

  ## Changes

  - Make Voxtral TTS preprocess consume nested `codes.audio` feedback.
  - Keep legacy top-level `audio` feedback compatibility.
  - Add CPU regression tests for nested and legacy audio feedback paths.
  - Add short-speech transcript containment fallback for minor ASR repeats.
  - Add tests ensuring `How... how are you?` passes but `I don't know, sorry.` still fails.

  ## Verification

  ```bash
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
    tests/helpers/test_assertions.py \
    tests/model_executor/models/voxtral_tts/test_tts_preprocess.py

  Result: 4 passed

  .venv/bin/python -m pytest -s \
    tests/e2e/online_serving/test_voxtral_tts_expansion.py::test_speech_english_basic \
    --run-level advanced_model

  Result: 1 passed
